import csv
import math
import sys

infile = sys.argv[1]
fg_out = 'foreground.tsv'
bg_out = 'background.tsv'
summary_out = 'prep_summary.tsv'
lfc_cutoff = 1.5
padj_cutoff = 0.05

with open(infile, newline='') as handle:
    reader = csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter='\t')
    required = {'rowname', 'log2FoldChange', 'padj'}
    missing = required - set(reader.fieldnames or [])
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit('Missing required columns: ' + ','.join(sorted(missing)))
    foreground = []
    background = []
    total_rows = 0
    nonmissing_padj = 0
    for row in reader:
        total_rows += 1
        gene = (row.get('rowname') or '').strip()
        if not gene:
            continue
        background.append(gene)
        padj_s = (row.get('padj') or '').strip()
        lfc_s = (row.get('log2FoldChange') or '').strip()
        if padj_s in {'', 'NA', 'NaN', 'nan'} or lfc_s in {'', 'NA', 'NaN', 'nan'}:
            continue
        padj = float(padj_s)
        lfc = float(lfc_s)
        if math.isfinite(padj):
            nonmissing_padj += 1
        if math.isfinite(lfc) and math.isfinite(padj) and lfc > lfc_cutoff and padj <= padj_cutoff:
            foreground.append(gene)

with open(fg_out, 'w', newline='') as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter='\t')
    writer.writerow(['gene_id'])
    for gene in foreground:
        writer.writerow([gene])
with open(bg_out, 'w', newline='') as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter='\t')
    writer.writerow(['gene_id'])
    for gene in background:
        writer.writerow([gene])
with open(summary_out, 'w', newline='') as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter='\t')
    writer.writerow(['metric', 'value'])
    writer.writerow(['lfc_rule', 'log2FoldChange > 1.5'])
    writer.writerow(['padj_rule', 'padj <= 0.05'])
    writer.writerow(['total_rows', total_rows])
    writer.writerow(['background_genes', len(background)])
    writer.writerow(['nonmissing_padj', nonmissing_padj])
    writer.writerow(['foreground_genes', len(foreground)])
PY

infile = sys.argv[1]
fg_out = 'foreground.tsv'
bg_out = 'background.tsv'
summary_out = 'prep_summary.tsv'
lfc_cutoff = 1.5
padj_cutoff = 0.05

with open(infile, newline='') as handle:
    reader = csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter='\t')
    required = {'rowname', 'log2FoldChange', 'padj'}
    missing = required - set(reader.fieldnames or [])
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit('Missing required columns: ' + ','.join(sorted(missing)))
    foreground = []
    background = []
    total_rows = 0
    nonmissing_padj = 0
    for row in reader:
        total_rows += 1
        gene = (row.get('rowname') or '').strip()
        if not gene:
            continue
        background.append(gene)
        padj_s = (row.get('padj') or '').strip()
        lfc_s = (row.get('log2FoldChange') or '').strip()
        if padj_s in {'', 'NA', 'NaN', 'nan'} or lfc_s in {'', 'NA', 'NaN', 'nan'}:
            continue
        padj = float(padj_s)
        lfc = float(lfc_s)
        if math.isfinite(padj):
            nonmissing_padj += 1
        if math.isfinite(lfc) and math.isfinite(padj) and lfc > lfc_cutoff and padj <= padj_cutoff:
            foreground.append(gene)

with open(fg_out, 'w', newline='') as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter='\t')
    writer.writerow(['gene_id'])
    for gene in foreground:
        writer.writerow([gene])
with open(bg_out, 'w', newline='') as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter='\t')
    writer.writerow(['gene_id'])
    for gene in background:
        writer.writerow([gene])
with open(summary_out, 'w', newline='') as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter='\t')
    writer.writerow(['metric', 'value'])
    writer.writerow(['lfc_rule', 'log2FoldChange > 1.5'])
    writer.writerow(['padj_rule', 'padj <= 0.05'])
    writer.writerow(['total_rows', total_rows])
    writer.writerow(['background_genes', len(background)])
    writer.writerow(['nonmissing_padj', nonmissing_padj])
    writer.writerow(['foreground_genes', len(foreground)])
PY

representation.name: FeMinus KEGG ABC transporter contributor count
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
Rscript - <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
res <- readRDS('$(inputs.rds.path)')
df <- as.data.frame(res)
df$gene <- rownames(df)
# DE foreground requested by the task: significantly upregulated in FeMinus vs FePlus.
fg <- df$gene[!is.na(df$padj) & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$padj <= 0.05 & abs(df$log2FoldChange) >= 1.5 & df$log2FoldChange > 0]
universe0 <- df$gene
# Retrieve KEGG mappings for Pseudomonas aeruginosa PA14 (organism code pau).
read_kegg <- function(url) {
  con <- url(url, open='rt')
  on.exit(close(con), add=TRUE)
  readLines(con, warn=FALSE)
}
link_lines <- read_kegg('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau')
list_lines <- read_kegg('https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau')
parse2 <- function(x) {
  parts <- strsplit(x, '\t', fixed=TRUE)
  data.frame(a=vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 1), b=vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 2), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}
links <- parse2(link_lines)
names_df <- parse2(list_lines)
links$gene <- sub('^pau:', '', links$a)
links$pathway <- sub('^path:', '', links$b)
names_df$pathway <- sub('^path:', '', names_df$a)
names_df$description <- sub(' - Pseudomonas aeruginosa PA14$', '', names_df$b)
# Use one homogeneous namespace and a mapped eligible universe.
links <- links[links$gene %in% universe0, c('gene','pathway')]
universe <- intersect(universe0, unique(links$gene))
fg_mapped <- intersect(fg, universe)
pathways <- split(links$gene, links$pathway)
N <- length(universe)
n <- length(fg_mapped)
out <- lapply(names(pathways), function(pid) {
  geneset <- intersect(unique(pathways[[pid]]), universe)
  k <- sum(fg_mapped %in% geneset)
  M <- length(geneset)
  p <- phyper(k - 1, M, N - M, n, lower.tail=FALSE)
  genes <- sort(intersect(fg_mapped, geneset))
  data.frame(ID=pid, Count=k, GeneRatio=paste0(k, '/', n), BgRatio=paste0(M, '/', N), pvalue=p, geneID=paste(genes, collapse='/'), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
})
enrich <- do.call(rbind, out)
enrich$p.adjust <- p.adjust(enrich$pvalue, method='BH')
enrich <- merge(enrich, names_df[, c('pathway','description')], by.x='ID', by.y='pathway', all.x=TRUE, sort=FALSE)
enrich <- enrich[enrich$Count > 0, c('ID','description','GeneRatio','BgRatio','pvalue','p.adjust','Count','geneID')]
enrich <- enrich[order(enrich$p.adjust, enrich$pvalue, enrich$ID), ]
abc <- enrich[enrich$description == 'ABC transporters' | grepl('^ABC transporters($| -)', enrich$description), ]
if (nrow(abc) != 1L) {
  write.table(enrich, file='details.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
  stop(paste('Expected one ABC transporters term, found', nrow(abc)))
}
contributors <- if (nchar(abc$geneID[1]) == 0) character(0) else strsplit(abc$geneID[1], '/', fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
answer <- length(unique(contributors))
writeLines(as.character(answer), 'answer.txt')
write.table(enrich, file='details.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT

representation.name: FeMinus upregulated KEGG enrichment
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(clusterProfiler))

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1L) stop("Expected one RDS input path")
res <- readRDS(args[[1]])

gene_id <- attr(res, "rownames")
ld <- attr(res, "listData")
required <- c("baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "padj")
if (is.null(gene_id) || is.null(ld) || !all(required %in% names(ld))) {
    stop("Input is not a compatible DESeqResults object")
}

base_mean <- as.numeric(ld[["baseMean"]])
log2fc <- as.numeric(ld[["log2FoldChange"]])
padj <- as.numeric(ld[["padj"]])
if (!all(lengths(list(gene_id, base_mean, log2fc, padj)) == length(gene_id))) {
    stop("DESeqResults columns have inconsistent lengths")
}

foreground_mask <- !is.na(log2fc) & !is.na(padj) & log2fc > 1.5 & padj < 0.05
foreground <- unique(gene_id[foreground_mask])
universe <- unique(gene_id)
if (length(foreground) == 0L) stop("No upregulated foreground genes passed thresholds")

ek <- enrichKEGG(
    gene = foreground,
    organism = "pau",
    keyType = "kegg",
    universe = universe,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500,
    use_internal_data = FALSE
)
result <- as.data.frame(ek)
if (nrow(result) == 0L) stop("KEGG enrichment returned no significant terms")
target <- result[result$Description == "ABC transporters", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(target) != 1L) {
    stop(sprintf("Expected exactly one ABC transporters term, found %d", nrow(target)))
}
contributors <- unique(strsplit(target$geneID[[1]], "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
if (length(contributors) != as.integer(target$Count[[1]])) {
    stop("Count field does not match unique contributing gene IDs")
}

write.table(result, file = "kegg_results.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, na = "")
write.table(
    data.frame(
        pathway_id = target$ID[[1]],
        description = target$Description[[1]],
        count = as.integer(target$Count[[1]]),
        pvalue = target$pvalue[[1]],
        p_adjust = target$p.adjust[[1]],
        qvalue = target$qvalue[[1]],
        contributing_genes = paste(contributors, collapse = ","),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    file = "abc_transporters.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE
)
summary <- data.frame(
    parameter = c(
        "clusterProfiler_version", "organism", "key_type", "contrast",
        "direction", "log2fc_cutoff", "padj_cutoff", "input_genes",
        "foreground_genes", "universe_genes", "p_adjust_method",
        "pvalue_cutoff", "qvalue_cutoff", "min_gs_size", "max_gs_size"
    ),
    value = c(
        as.character(packageVersion("clusterProfiler")), "pau", "kegg",
        "GluFe_vs_GluFePlus", "upregulated", "1.5", "0.05",
        length(gene_id), length(foreground), length(universe), "BH",
        "0.05", "0.2", "10", "500"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(summary, file = "run_summary.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.input.path)"

cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(clusterProfiler))

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1L) stop("Expected one RDS input path")
res <- readRDS(args[[1]])

gene_id <- attr(res, "rownames")
ld <- attr(res, "listData")
required <- c("baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "padj")
if (is.null(gene_id) || is.null(ld) || !all(required %in% names(ld))) {
    stop("Input is not a compatible DESeqResults object")
}

base_mean <- as.numeric(ld[["baseMean"]])
log2fc <- as.numeric(ld[["log2FoldChange"]])
padj <- as.numeric(ld[["padj"]])
if (!all(lengths(list(gene_id, base_mean, log2fc, padj)) == length(gene_id))) {
    stop("DESeqResults columns have inconsistent lengths")
}

foreground_mask <- !is.na(log2fc) & !is.na(padj) & log2fc > 1.5 & padj < 0.05
foreground <- unique(gene_id[foreground_mask])
universe <- unique(gene_id)
if (length(foreground) == 0L) stop("No upregulated foreground genes passed thresholds")

ek <- enrichKEGG(
    gene = foreground,
    organism = "pau",
    keyType = "kegg",
    universe = universe,
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500,
    use_internal_data = FALSE
)
result <- as.data.frame(ek)
if (nrow(result) == 0L) stop("KEGG enrichment returned no tested terms")
target <- result[result$Description == "ABC transporters", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(target) != 1L) {
    stop(sprintf("Expected exactly one ABC transporters term, found %d", nrow(target)))
}
contributors <- unique(strsplit(target$geneID[[1]], "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
if (length(contributors) != as.integer(target$Count[[1]])) {
    stop("Count field does not match unique contributing gene IDs")
}

write.table(result, file = "kegg_results.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, na = "")
write.table(
    data.frame(
        pathway_id = target$ID[[1]],
        description = target$Description[[1]],
        count = as.integer(target$Count[[1]]),
        pvalue = target$pvalue[[1]],
        p_adjust = target$p.adjust[[1]],
        qvalue = target$qvalue[[1]],
        contributing_genes = paste(contributors, collapse = ","),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    file = "abc_transporters.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE
)
summary <- data.frame(
    parameter = c(
        "clusterProfiler_version", "organism", "key_type", "contrast",
        "direction", "log2fc_cutoff", "padj_cutoff", "input_genes",
        "foreground_genes", "universe_genes", "p_adjust_method",
        "pathway_output_pvalue_cutoff", "pathway_output_qvalue_cutoff",
        "min_gs_size", "max_gs_size"
    ),
    value = c(
        as.character(packageVersion("clusterProfiler")), "pau", "kegg",
        "GluFe_vs_GluFePlus", "upregulated", "1.5", "0.05",
        length(gene_id), length(foreground), length(universe), "BH",
        "1", "1", "10", "500"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(summary, file = "run_summary.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)

x<-readRDS('inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds'); ld<-attr(x,'listData'); rn<-attr(x,'rownames')
up <- rn["'!is.na(ld$padj) & ld$padj < .05 & !is.na(ld$log2FoldChange) & ld$log2FoldChange > 1.5]
links <- read.delim('"'/tmp/pau_pathway_links.tsv',header=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE,col.names=c('gene','pathway'))
links"'$gene <- sub('"'"'^pau:'"','',links"'$gene); links$pathway <- sub('"'"'^path:'"','',links"'$pathway)
abc <- unique(links$gene[links$pathway=='"'pau02010'])
hits <- intersect(up,abc)
cat('foreground=',length(up),' abc_members=',length(abc),' overlap=',length(hits),'\\n',sep='')
cat(paste(hits,collapse='\\n'),'\\n')
# reconstruct ORA against all pathway-annotated PA14 genes; clusterProfiler default universe
universe<-unique(links"'$gene)
fg<-intersect(up,universe)
N<-length(universe); M<-length(intersect(abc,universe)); n<-length(fg); k<-length(intersect(fg,abc))
p<-phyper(k-1,M,N-M,n,lower.tail=FALSE)
# one-sided p for all pathways, BH among nonzero overlap terms, like tested terms
ps<-sapply(split(links$gene,links$pathway),function(g){mm<-length(unique(g)); kk<-length(intersect(fg,unique(g))); if(kk==0) NA_real_ else phyper(kk-1,mm,N-mm,n,lower.tail=FALSE)})
padj<-p.adjust(ps[!is.na(ps)],method='"'BH')
cat(sprintf('mapped foreground=%d universe=%d k=%d p=%.6g BH=%.6g tested_hit_terms=%d\\n',n,N,k,p,padj[['pau02010']],length(padj)))
RS"

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

representation.name: FeMinus numeric foreground and background
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python - "$(inputs.input.path)" <<'PY'
import csv
import math
import sys

input_path = sys.argv[1]
required = {"rowname", "log2FoldChange", "padj"}
seen = set()
background = []
foreground = []

with open(input_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    reader = csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t")
    if reader.fieldnames is None or not required.issubset(set(reader.fieldnames)):
        raise SystemExit("Input must contain rowname, log2FoldChange, and padj columns")
    for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
        gene_id = (row.get("rowname") or "").strip()
        if not gene_id:
            raise SystemExit("Blank gene identifier at input row %d" % row_number)
        if gene_id in seen:
            raise SystemExit("Duplicate gene identifier: %s" % gene_id)
        seen.add(gene_id)
        background.append(gene_id)
        try:
            lfc = float(row["log2FoldChange"])
            padj = float(row["padj"])
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        if math.isfinite(lfc) and math.isfinite(padj) and lfc > 0 and abs(lfc) >= 1.5 and padj <= 0.05:
            foreground.append(gene_id)

with open("foreground.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    handle.write("gene_id\n")
    handle.write("\n".join(foreground))
    handle.write("\n")

with open("background.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    handle.write("gene_id\n")
    handle.write("\n".join(background))
    handle.write("\n")
PY

import csv
import sys

def convert(input_path, output_path):
    with open(input_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter="\t")
        if reader.fieldnames is None or "gene_id" not in reader.fieldnames:
            raise SystemExit("Expected a gene_id column")
        values = []
        for row in reader:

                raise SystemExit("Blank gene identifier")
            if not gene_id.startswith("paf:"):
                gene_id = "paf:" + gene_id
            values.append(gene_id)
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        handle.write("gene_id\n")
        handle.write("\n".join(values))
        handle.write("\n")

convert(sys.argv[2], "background_paf.tsv")

representation.name: Find KEGG code for PA14 loci
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
test -r "$(inputs.anchor.path)"
python - <<'PY'
from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
from urllib.request import urlopen

codes = ["pae","paf","pag","pah","pai","paj","pak","pal","pam","pan","pao","pap","paq","par","pas","pat","pau","pav","paw","pax","pay","paz"]
with open("pseudomonas_code_scan.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
    out.write("code\tmapping_rows\tPA14_hits\tfirst_mapping\n")
    for code in codes:
        try:
            text = urlopen("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/" + code, timeout=20).read().decode("utf-8")
            rows = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line]
            hits = [line for line in rows if "PA14_" in line]
            first = rows[0] if rows else ""
            out.write("%s\t%d\t%d\t%s\n" % (code, len(rows), len(hits), first))
        except (HTTPError, URLError, TimeoutError) as exc:
            out.write("%s\tERROR\tERROR\t%s\n" % (code, type(exc).__name__))
PY

    if reader.fieldnames is None or not required.issubset(set(reader.fieldnames)):

print(r.status_code,len(r.text))
lines=r.text.strip().splitlines()
print('link lines',len(lines))
# unique gene ids
genes=set()
pathways=set()
for line in lines:
 g,p=line.split('\\t')
 genes.add(g.split(':')[1]); pathways.add(p.split(':')[1])
print('unique genes in pathways',len(genes),'pathways',len(pathways))
# sample genes
print(sorted(genes)[:10], sorted(genes)[-10:])
# DESeq rows count local table
import csv
rows=0; ids=set()
for line in open('/workspace/tmp/table.tsv'):
 if rows==0: rows+=1; continue
 f=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t'); ids.add(f[0]); rows+=1
print('DESeq rows',rows-1, 'unique',len(ids))
print('intersection',len(ids & genes), 'DE genes not in pathway',len(ids-genes), 'pathway genes not in DE',len(genes-ids))
# ABC transporter pathway genes
abc=set()
for line in lines:
 g,p=line.split('\\t')
 if p=='path:pau02010': abc.add(g.split(':')[1])

fids=set(); fh=True
for line in open('/workspace/tmp/filtered.tsv'):

path2genes=defaultdict(set)
gene2paths=defaultdict(set)
for line in link:

    g,p=line.split('\\t')
    # g = pau:PA14_xxxx ; p=path:pauYYYYY
    gene=g.split(':',1)[1]
    path=p.split(':',1)[1]  # includes pau02010? from link output path:pau02010, so after ':' = pau02010
    path2genes[path].add(gene)
    gene2paths[gene].add(path)
print('pathways',len(path2genes),'annotated genes',len(gene2paths))
# all annotated genes in organism universe
universe=set(gene2paths)
N=len(universe); n=len(up & universe)

# pathway metadata names
lst=urllib.request.urlopen('https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau', timeout=120).read().decode().splitlines()
pathname={}
for line in lst:
    if '\\t' in line:
        p,name=line.split('\\t',1)
        pathname[p]=name
# hypergeom sf
def sf(x,N,K,n):
    # P(X>=x), exact log sum
    total=math.lgamma(N+1)-math.lgamma(n+1)-math.lgamma(N-n+1)
    logden=total
    logs=[]
    lo=max(0,n-(N-K)); hi=min(n,K)
    for i in range(x,hi+1):
        lp=(math.lgamma(K+1)-math.lgamma(i+1)-math.lgamma(K-i+1)) + (math.lgamma(N-K+1)-math.lgamma(n-i+1)-math.lgamma(N-K-(n-i)+1))
        logs.append(lp-logden)
    m=max(logs)
    return math.exp(m)*sum(math.exp(l-m) for l in logs)

    K=len(genes)
    x=len(up & genes)
    if x==0: continue
    p=sf(x,N,K,n)
    rows.append((p,path,x,K,genes))

    val=min(1,max(prev,val))

        print('genes',sorted(up & genes))
# top significant by BH

    r=next((j+1 for j,q in enumerate(ps) if q==p), None)
    adjv=p*m/r
    # this BH ignores ties; approximate
    res.append((adjv,path,p,x,K))

    parts=l.split('\\t')

        g=parts[0].split(':')[-1]; p=parts[1].split(':')[-1]
        pairs.append((g,p))
# path list names
plist=urllib.request.urlopen('https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau',timeout=30).read().decode()
path_ids=set(l.split('\\t')[0].replace('path:','') for l in plist.splitlines() if '\\t' in l)
# only path ids in list
pairs=[(g,p) for g,p in pairs if p in path_ids]
path2genes=defaultdict(set)
for g,p in pairs: path2genes[p].add(g)
extID={g for g,p in pairs}

input_genes=up & extID

N=len(extID); n=len(input_genes)

    pval=sum(comb(M,i)*comb(N-M,n-i) for i in range(k,min(M,n)+1))/comb(N,n) if k<=n and n<=N else 1

import csv

# Read the tabular file and filter
genes_up = []
total = 0
with open('/workspace/rds_table.tabular', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t')
    for row in reader:
        total += 1
        try:
            log2fc = float(row['log2FoldChange'])
            padj = float(row['padj'])
        except (ValueError, KeyError):
            continue
        if log2fc > 1.5 and padj < 0.05:
            genes_up.append(row['rowname'])

print(f"Total genes: {total}")
print(f"Upregulated genes (log2FC > 1.5, padj < 0.05): {len(genes_up)}")

# Write the gene list for upload to Galaxy
with open('/workspace/upregulated_genes.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write("gene_id\n")
    for g in genes_up:
        f.write(f"{g}\n")

# Also show first few
print(f"First 10 gene IDs: {genes_up[:10]}")
PYEOF

import os

# Read the table and filter for upregulated genes
table_path = "/workspace/rds_table.tabular"
upregulated_genes = []

with open(table_path) as f:
    header = f.readline()
    for line in f:
        cols = line.strip().split('\t')
        if len(cols) < 7:
            continue
        gene = cols[0]
        try:
            log2fc = float(cols[2])
            padj = float(cols[6])
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            continue
        # Upregulated: log2FC > 1.5 AND padj < 0.05
        if log2fc > 1.5 and padj < 0.05:
            upregulated_genes.append(gene)

print(f"Total genes: {5828}")
print(f"Upregulated (log2FC > 1.5, padj < 0.05): {len(upregulated_genes)}")
print(f"First 20 genes: {upregulated_genes[:20]}")
print(f"Last 20 genes: {upregulated_genes[-20:]}")

# Write gene list for upload
output_path = "/workspace/upregulated_genes.txt"
with open(output_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write("gene_id\n")
    for gene in upregulated_genes:
        f.write(f"{gene}\n")
print(f"\nGene list written to {output_path}")

# Count genes contributing to ABC transporters from the contributing genes output
abc_genes = []
with open("/workspace/kegg_contributing_genes.tabular") as f:
    header = f.readline()
    for line in f:
        cols = line.strip().split('\t')
        if len(cols) >= 3 and cols[0] == 'pau02010':
            abc_genes.append(cols[2])

print(f"ABC transporters (pau02010) contributing genes: {len(abc_genes)}")
for g in abc_genes:
    print(f"  {g}")

# Also verify from pathway results
print("\n=== From pathway results ===")
with open("/workspace/kegg_pathway_results.tabular") as f:
    header = f.readline()
    for line in f:
        cols = line.strip().split('\t')
        if len(cols) >= 3 and 'ABC transporters' in cols[1]:
            print(f"Pathway: {cols[0]} - {cols[1]}")
            print(f"Foreground hits: {cols[2]}")
            print(f"Genes: {cols[8]}")
            genes = cols[8].split(',')
            print(f"Gene count: {len(genes)}")

import json

API_KEY = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"

new_history = gi.histories.create_history(
    name="FeMinus KEGG ABC transporters analysis"
)
new_history_id = new_history["id"]
print(f"Created new history: {new_history_id}")
print(f"History name: {new_history['name']}")

# List seed history contents
print("\nSeed history contents:")
seed_contents = gi.histories.show_history(SEED_HISTORY_ID, contents=True)
for item in seed_contents:
    print(f"  {item['hid']}: {item['name']} (id={item['id']}, type={item['history_content_type']})")

# Copy datasets from seed to new history
print("\nCopying datasets...")
for item in seed_contents:
    if item['history_content_type'] == 'dataset':
        try:
            result = gi.histories.copy_dataset(
                history_id=new_history_id,
                source_history_id=SEED_HISTORY_ID,
                dataset_id=item['id'],

# Verify new history

for item in new_contents:
    print(f"  {item['hid']}: {item['name']} (id={item['id']}, type={item['history_content_type']})")

print(f"\nNEW_HISTORY_ID={new_history_id}")

import requests

# Get gene-to-pathway mapping
r1 = requests.get("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau", timeout=30)
link_lines = r1.text.strip().split('\n')

# Get pathway names
r2 = requests.get("https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau", timeout=30)
path_lines = r2.text.strip().split('\n')

# Build pathway name lookup
pathway_names = {}
for line in path_lines:
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        pathway_names[parts[0]] = parts[1]

# Create 3-column mapping: gene_id, pathway_id, pathway_name
mapping = []

MAPPING_OLD = "f9cad7b01a47213525f278bce1643b78"

            files={'files_0|file_data': f},

        print(line)

# Download contributing genes - find ABC transporters
r3 = requests.get(f"{base_url}/datasets/{CONTRIBUTING_GENES}/display", headers=headers)
print("\n=== CONTRIBUTING GENES - ABC transporters ===")
abc_lines = []
for line in r3.text.strip().split('\n'):
    if 'ABC' in line or '02010' in line:
        abc_lines.append(line)
        print(line)

print(f"\nNumber of ABC transporter contributing gene rows: {len(abc_lines)}")

# Count unique genes
if abc_lines:
    header_parts = abc_lines[0].split('\t')
    if 'gene_id' in header_parts[0]:
        data_lines = abc_lines[1:]  # skip header
    else:
        data_lines = abc_lines
    
    unique_genes = set()
    for line in data_lines:
        parts = line.split('\t')
        if len(parts) >= 3:
            unique_genes.add(parts[2])  # gene_id is 3rd column

    for g in sorted(unique_genes):

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import requests
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import csv

# Load the gene data
df = pd.read_csv("/workspace/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.csv")
print(f"Total genes: {len(df)}")

# Filter upregulated
up_mask = (df['log2FoldChange'] > 1.5) & (df['padj'] < 0.05)
up_genes = set(df.loc[up_mask, 'gene'].tolist())
print(f"Upregulated genes: {len(up_genes)}")

# All background genes
all_genes = set(df['gene'].tolist())
print(f"All genes: {len(all_genes)}")

# Get KEGG pathway to gene mapping for P. aeruginosa PA14
# Organism code: pau
print("\nFetching KEGG pathway-gene links...")
url = "http://rest.kegg.jp/link/pau/pathway"
response = requests.get(url, timeout=60)
print(f"Response status: {response.status_code}")
print(f"Response length: {len(response.text)}")

# Parse the mapping
pathway_to_genes = {}
gene_to_pathways = {}
for line in response.text.strip().split('\n'):
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        gene_id = parts[0].strip()  # e.g., pau:PA14_33530
        pathway_id = parts[1].strip()  # e.g., path:pau02010

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import requests
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import csv

# Load gene data
df = pd.read_csv("/workspace/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.csv")

# Upregulated genes
up_mask = (df['log2FoldChange'] > 1.5) & (df['padj'] < 0.05)
up_genes = set(df.loc[up_mask, 'gene'].tolist())
print(f"Upregulated genes (total): {len(up_genes)}")

# All genes
all_genes = set(df['gene'].tolist())

# Get KEGG pathway-gene mapping
url = "http://rest.kegg.jp/link/pau/pathway"
response = requests.get(url, timeout=60)

pathway_to_genes = {}
for line in response.text.strip().split('\n'):
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        path_id = parts[0].strip().replace('path:', '')
        gene_id = parts[1].strip().replace('pau:', '')
        if path_id not in pathway_to_genes:
            pathway_to_genes[path_id] = set()
        pathway_to_genes[path_id].add(gene_id)

# Background: genes with KEGG annotations that are in our dataset
kegg_annotated = set()
for genes in pathway_to_genes.values():
    kegg_annotated |= genes
kegg_annotated = kegg_annotated & all_genes  # Only genes in our dataset

print(f"KEGG-annotated genes in our data: {len(kegg_annotated)}")

# Upregulated genes that have KEGG annotations
up_kegg = up_genes & kegg_annotated
print(f"Upregulated with KEGG annotations: {len(up_kegg)}")

# Get pathway names
url2 = "http://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau"
response2 = requests.get(url2, timeout=60)
pathway_names = {}
for line in response2.text.strip().split('\n'):
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        path_id = parts[0].strip().replace('path:', '')
        path_name = parts[1].strip()
        pathway_names[path_id] = path_name

# Find ABC transporters
abc_pathway_id = None
for pid, pname in pathway_names.items():
    if 'ABC transporters' in pname:
        abc_pathway_id = pid
        print(f"\nABC transporters pathway: {pid} - {pname}")
        break

# ABC transporters genes
abc_genes = pathway_to_genes.get(abc_pathway_id, set())
abc_genes_in_data = abc_genes & all_genes
print(f"ABC transporters genes in our data: {len(abc_genes_in_data)}")

# Upregulated genes that are in ABC transporters
up_in_abc = up_genes & abc_genes_in_data
print(f"Upregulated genes in ABC transporters: {len(up_in_abc)}")
print(f"Genes: {sorted(up_in_abc)}")

# Now do full KEGG enrichment analysis
print("\n--- KEGG Enrichment Analysis ---")
print(f"Background size: {len(kegg_annotated)}")
print(f"Significant (upregulated): {len(up_kegg)}")

N = len(kegg_annotated)  # Total background
n = len(up_kegg)          # Total significant

results = []
for pid, pathway_genes in pathway_to_genes.items():
    pw_in_data = pathway_genes & kegg_annotated
    M = len(pw_in_data)  # Genes in pathway
    
    if M < 2:  # Skip pathways with too few genes
        continue
    
    # Overlap
    overlap = up_kegg & pw_in_data
    k = len(overlap)  # Significant genes in pathway
    
    if k == 0:
        continue
    
    # 2x2 contingency table
    #                In pathway    Not in pathway
    # Significant       k              n - k
    # Not significant   M - k          N - M - (n - k)
    
    a = k
    b = M - k
    c = n - k
    d = N - M - (n - k)
    
    odds_ratio, p_value = fisher_exact([[a, b], [c, d]], alternative='greater')
    
    results.append({
        'pathway_id': pid,
        'pathway_name': pathway_names.get(pid, 'Unknown'),
        'pathway_size': M,
        'overlap': k,
        'p_value': p_value,
        'odds_ratio': odds_ratio,
        'genes': sorted(overlap)
    })

# Multiple testing correction
results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
if len(results_df) > 0:
    reject, pvals_corrected, _, _ = multipletests(results_df['p_value'].values, method='fdr_bh')
    results_df['padj'] = pvals_corrected
    results_df = results_df.sort_values('padj')
    
    # Show top results
    print("\nTop 20 enriched pathways:")
    for i, row in results_df.head(20).iterrows():
        print(f"  {row['pathway_id']}: {row['pathway_name']} - {row['overlap']}/{row['pathway_size']} genes, p={row['p_value']:.2e}, padj={row['padj']:.2e}")
    
    # Show ABC transporters specifically
    abc_row = results_df[results_df['pathway_id'] == abc_pathway_id]
    if len(abc_row) > 0:
        row = abc_row.iloc[0]
        print(f"\n--- ABC transporters ---")
        print(f"Pathway ID: {row['pathway_id']}")
        print(f"Pathway name: {row['pathway_name']}")
        print(f"Pathway size: {row['pathway_size']}")
        print(f"Overlap (upregulated genes): {row['overlap']}")
        print(f"p-value: {row['p_value']:.6e}")
        print(f"Adjusted p-value: {row['padj']:.6e}")
        print(f"Genes: {row['genes']}")
    else:
        print(f"\nABC transporters not found in enrichment results (no overlap)")
        # Check if there are any upregulated genes in this pathway
        abc_in_data = pathway_to_genes.get(abc_pathway_id, set()) & kegg_annotated
        abc_up = up_kegg & abc_in_data
        print(f"ABC pathway genes in data: {len(abc_in_data)}")
        print(f"ABC pathway genes upregulated: {len(abc_up)}")
        if len(abc_up) > 0:
            print(f"Genes: {abc_up}")

    b = M - k
    c = n - k
    d = N - M - (n - k)
    
    odds_ratio, p_value = fisher_exact([[a, b], [c, d]], alternative='greater')
    
    results.append({
        'pathway_id': pid,
        'pathway_name': pathway_names.get(pid, 'Unknown'),
        'pathway_size': M,
        'overlap': k,
        'p_value': p_value,
        'odds_ratio': odds_ratio,
        'genes': sorted(overlap)
    })

# Multiple testing correction
results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
if len(results_df) > 0:
    reject, pvals_corrected, _, _ = multipletests(results_df['p_value'].values, method='fdr_bh')
    results_df['padj'] = pvals_corrected
    results_df = results_df.sort_values('padj')
    
    # Show top results
    print("\nTop 20 enriched pathways:")
    for i, row in results_df.head(20).iterrows():
        print(f"  {row['pathway_id']}: {row['pathway_name']} - {row['overlap']}/{row['pathway_size']} genes, p={row['p_value']:.2e}, padj={row['padj']:.2e}")
    
    # Show ABC transporters specifically
    abc_row = results_df[results_df['pathway_id'] == abc_pathway_id]
    if len(abc_row) > 0:
        row = abc_row.iloc[0]
        print(f"\n--- ABC transporters ---")
        print(f"Pathway ID: {row['pathway_id']}")
        print(f"Pathway name: {row['pathway_name']}")
        print(f"Pathway size: {row['pathway_size']}")
        print(f"Overlap (upregulated genes): {row['overlap']}")
        print(f"p-value: {row['p_value']:.6e}")
        print(f"Adjusted p-value: {row['padj']:.6e}")
        print(f"Genes: {row['genes']}")
    else:
        print(f"\nABC transporters not found in enrichment results (no overlap)")
        # Check if there are any upregulated genes in this pathway
        abc_in_data = pathway_to_genes.get(abc_pathway_id, set()) & kegg_annotated
        abc_up = up_kegg & abc_in_data
        print(f"ABC pathway genes in data: {len(abc_in_data)}")

        if len(abc_up) > 0:
            print(f"Genes: {abc_up}")

cat("First 10 upregulated genes:\n")
print(head(up[, c("gene_id", "log2FoldChange", "padj")], 10))

# PA14 has "pae" as the KEGG organism code (same as PAO1)
# But KEGG also has "pau" for PA14 specifically?

# Let me check the KEGG API

    base = "https://rest.kegg.jp"
    url = f"{base}/{operation}"
    if params:

    with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as resp:

# Try to list organisms

import csv
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

# 1. Load DE results
de_data = []
with open("/workspace/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.csv") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        de_data.append({
            'gene_id': row['gene_id'].strip(),
            'log2FC': float(row['log2FoldChange']),
            'padj': float(row['padj']) if row['padj'] != 'NA' else None
        })

print(f"Total DE genes: {len(de_data)}")

# 2. Define foreground: significantly upregulated
# |log2FC| > 1.5 (absolute) AND upregulated means log2FC > 1.5
# padj < 0.05
foreground_genes = set()
for g in de_data:
    if g['padj'] is not None and g['padj'] < 0.05 and g['log2FC'] > 1.5:
        foreground_genes.add(g['gene_id'])

print(f"Foreground (upregulated, log2FC>1.5, padj<0.05): {len(foreground_genes)}")

# Also get full DE gene set for universe
all_de_genes = set(g['gene_id'] for g in de_data)
print(f"All DE genes: {len(all_de_genes)}")

# 3. Load KEGG genes (universe of all KEGG-mapped genes in PA14)
kegg_genes = set()
with open("/workspace/pau_genes.txt") as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        # Format: pau:PA14_XXXXX\t...
        parts = line.split('\t')
        kegg_id = parts[0]
        # Extract PA14_XXXXX from pau:PA14_XXXXX
        gene_locus = kegg_id.replace("pau:", "")
        kegg_genes.add(gene_locus)

print(f"KEGG genes (pau): {len(kegg_genes)}")

# 4. Load pathway-gene mappings
pathway_genes = defaultdict(set)  # pathway_id -> set of PA14 genes
gene_pathways = defaultdict(set)  # gene -> set of pathway ids

with open("/workspace/pau_pathway_links.txt") as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        # Format: path:pauXXXXX\tpau:PA14_XXXXX
        parts = line.split('\t')
        pathway_id = parts[0].replace("path:", "")  # e.g., pau02010
        gene_id = parts[1].replace("pau:", "")  # e.g., PA14_00360
        pathway_genes[pathway_id].add(gene_id)
        gene_pathways[gene_id].add(pathway_id)

print(f"Pathways: {len(pathway_genes)}")

# 5. Load pathway names
pathway_names = {}
with open("/workspace/pau_pathways.txt") as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split('\t')
        pid = parts[0]  # e.g., pau02010
        pname = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
        pathway_names[pid] = pname

# Find ABC transporters pathway
abc_pathway_id = None
for pid, pname in pathway_names.items():
    if "ABC transporter" in pname:
        abc_pathway_id = pid
        print(f"\nABC transporters pathway ID: {abc_pathway_id}, Name: {pname}")
        break

# 6. Universe: all DE genes that can be mapped to KEGG
# First check which DE genes have KEGG mappings
de_genes_in_kegg = all_de_genes & kegg_genes
print(f"\nDE genes with KEGG mapping: {len(de_genes_in_kegg)}")

# Foreground genes with KEGG mapping
fg_in_kegg = foreground_genes & kegg_genes
print(f"Foreground genes with KEGG mapping: {len(fg_in_kegg)}")

# Also check genes without KEGG mapping
fg_not_in_kegg = foreground_genes - kegg_genes
print(f"Foreground genes WITHOUT KEGG mapping: {len(fg_not_in_kegg)}")
if fg_not_in_kegg:
    print(f"  Examples: {list(fg_not_in_kegg)[:10]}")

# Universe = all DE genes that have KEGG mapping
universe = de_genes_in_kegg
print(f"\nUniverse size (DE genes with KEGG mapping): {len(universe)}")

# 7. ORA: Fisher's exact test for each pathway
# Only test pathways that have genes in the universe
results = []
for pid, pathway_gene_set in pathway_genes.items():
    pathway_in_universe = pathway_gene_set & universe
    if len(pathway_in_universe) == 0:
        continue
    
    # Contingency table:
    #                    In pathway    Not in pathway
    # In foreground          a              b
    # Not in foreground      c              d
    
    a = len(fg_in_kegg & pathway_gene_set)  # foreground genes in pathway
    b = len(fg_in_kegg) - a  # foreground genes not in pathway
    c = len(pathway_in_universe) - a  # background genes in pathway
    d = len(universe) - len(fg_in_kegg) - c  # background genes not in pathway
    
    if a == 0:
        continue  # Skip pathways with no foreground genes
    
    # Fisher's exact test (one-tailed for over-representation)
    table = [[a, b], [c, d]]
    odds_ratio, p_value = fisher_exact(table, alternative='greater')
    
    pname = pathway_names.get(pid, pid)
    results.append({
        'pathway_id': pid,
        'pathway_name': pname,
        'overlap': a,
        'pathway_size': len(pathway_in_universe),
        'p_value': p_value,
        'odds_ratio': odds_ratio
    })

print(f"\nPathways tested: {len(results)}")

# 8. Multiple testing correction (Benjamini-Hochberg)
if results:
    pvals = [r['p_value'] for r in results]
    reject, padj, _, _ = multipletests(pvals, method='fdr_bh')
    for i, r in enumerate(results):
        r['padj'] = padj[i]
        r['significant'] = reject[i]

# 9. Find ABC transporters result
abc_result = None
for r in results:
    if r['pathway_id'] == abc_pathway_id:
        abc_result = r
        break

print(f"\n--- ABC Transporters Enrichment ---")
if abc_result:
    print(f"Pathway: {abc_result['pathway_name']}")
    print(f"Pathway ID: {abc_result['pathway_id']}")
    print(f"Overlap (foreground genes in pathway): {abc_result['overlap']}")
    print(f"Pathway size (in universe): {abc_result['pathway_size']}")
    print(f"Fisher p-value: {abc_result['p_value']:.6e}")
    print(f"Adjusted p-value (FDR): {abc_result['padj']:.6e}")
    print(f"Significant at padj<0.05: {abc_result['significant']}")
else:
    print("ABC transporters NOT found in enrichment results!")

# 10. Show top enriched pathways for context
results_sorted = sorted(results, key=lambda r: r['padj'])
print(f"\n--- Top 10 Enriched Pathways ---")
for i, r in enumerate(results_sorted[:10]):
    print(f"{i+1}. {r['pathway_name']} (ID: {r['pathway_id']}): overlap={r['overlap']}, padj={r['padj']:.4e}")

# 11. Verify: list the specific genes that overlap
if abc_result:
    abc_genes_in_pathway = pathway_genes[abc_pathway_id]
    overlapping_genes = fg_in_kegg & abc_genes_in_pathway
    print(f"\n--- {len(overlapping_genes)} Overlapping Genes for ABC Transporters ---")
    for g in sorted(overlapping_genes):
        # Find the log2FC and padj for this gene
        for d in de_data:
            if d['gene_id'] == g:
                print(f"  {g}: log2FC={d['log2FC']:.3f}, padj={d['padj']:.4e}")
                break
PYEOF

Rscript -e '
x <- readRDS("inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds")
ld <- attr(x, "listData")
rn <- attr(x, "rownames")

# Filter for up: log2FC > 1.5, padj < 0.05
keep <- which(!is.na(ld$padj) & ld$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(ld$log2FoldChange) & ld$log2FoldChange > 1.5)
up_genes <- rn[keep]
cat("Upregulated genes:", length(up_genes), "\n")

# Read the ABC transporters pathway genes
abc_lines <- readLines("/workspace/pau_pathway_links.txt")
abc_genes_kegg <- unique(gsub("pau:", "", 
  sapply(strsplit(grep("pau02010", abc_lines, value=TRUE), "\t"), `[`, 2)))
cat("ABC transporters KEGG genes:", length(abc_genes_kegg), "\n")

# Overlap
overlap <- intersect(up_genes, abc_genes_kegg)
cat("Overlap count:", length(overlap), "\n")
cat("Overlapping genes:\n")
for (g in sort(overlap)) {
  idx <- which(rn == g)[1]
  cat(sprintf("  %s: log2FC=%.3f, padj=%.4e\n", g, ld$log2FoldChange[idx], ld$padj[idx]))
}
' 2>&1

source $HOME/miniforge3/bin/activate rtools && Rscript -e '
library(DESeq2)
library(clusterProfiler)

res <- readRDS("inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds")

# Upregulated genes
up_genes <- rownames(res)[which(res$log2FoldChange > 1.5 & res$padj < 0.05)]
cat("Number of upregulated genes:", length(up_genes), "\n")

# Universe: all genes with non-NA padj (all genes tested)
universe <- rownames(res)[which(!is.na(res$padj))]
cat("Universe size:", length(universe), "\n")

# Try KEGG enrichment with organism pau (P. aeruginosa PA14)
cat("\nRunning enrichKEGG...\n")
kegg_res <- enrichKEGG(
  gene = up_genes,
  universe = universe,
  organism = "pau",
  keyType = "kegg",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

cat("KEGG results:\n")
print(head(as.data.frame(kegg_res), 20))

# Check for ABC transporters
abc_rows <- grep("ABC transporter", as.data.frame(kegg_res)$Description, ignore.case=TRUE)
cat("\nABC transporters rows:\n")
if(length(abc_rows) > 0) {
  abc_data <- as.data.frame(kegg_res)[abc_rows, ]
  print(abc_data)
  cat("\nGene IDs in ABC transporters:\n")
  cat(abc_data$geneID, "\n")
  # Count the genes
  genes_in_abc <- strsplit(abc_data$geneID, "/")[[1]]
  cat("\nNumber of genes:", length(genes_in_abc), "\n")
  cat("Gene list:", paste(genes_in_abc, collapse=", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("No ABC transporters found\n")
}
' 2>&1

events.command:
source $HOME/miniforge3/bin/activate rtools && Rscript -e '
library(DESeq2)
library(clusterProfiler)

res <- readRDS("inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds")

# Upregulated genes
up_genes <- rownames(res)[which(res$log2FoldChange > 1.5 & res$padj < 0.05)]
cat("Number of upregulated genes:", length(up_genes), "\n")

# Universe
universe <- rownames(res)[which(!is.na(res$padj))]
cat("Universe size:", length(universe), "\n")

# Run KEGG enrichment
kegg_res <- enrichKEGG(
  gene = up_genes,
  universe = universe,
  organism = "pau",
  keyType = "kegg",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

# Verify: how many foreground genes mapped to KEGG?
cat("\nForeground genes mapped to KEGG:", length(kegg_res@gene), "\n")
cat("Universe genes mapped to KEGG:", length(kegg_res@universe), "\n")

# Detailed ABC transporters info
abc_df <- as.data.frame(kegg_res)
abc_row <- abc_df[grep("ABC transporter", abc_df$Description, ignore.case=TRUE), ]
cat("\n--- ABC transporters detail ---\n")
cat("GeneRatio:", abc_row$GeneRatio, "\n")
cat("BgRatio:", abc_row$BgRatio, "\n")
cat("Count:", abc_row$Count, "\n")
cat("p.adjust:", abc_row$p.adjust, "\n")
cat("geneID:", abc_row$geneID, "\n")

# Verify the genes are actually in the upregulated set
abc_genes <- strsplit(abc_row$geneID, "/")[[1]]
cat("\nABC transporter genes:", length(abc_genes), "\n")
cat("All in upregulated set:", all(abc_genes %in% up_genes), "\n")

# Show the individual genes with their fold changes
cat("\nGene details:\n")
for (g in abc_genes) {
  idx <- which(rownames(res) == g)
  cat(sprintf("  %s: log2FC=%.4f, padj=%.4e\n", g, res$log2FoldChange[idx], res$padj[idx]))
}
' 2>&1
